SELECT 
  e.id, e.name, e.description, e.from_date, e.to_date,
  e.city, e.country, e.website, e.style, e.image_url,
  e.ai_quality_score, e.ai_completeness_score, e.extraction_method,
  e.created_at, e.updated_at,
  CASE 
    WHEN LOWER(e.name) = LOWER(''Vicci'') THEN 100.0
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM event_teachers et 
      JOIN teachers t ON et.teacher_id = t.id 
      WHERE et.event_id = e.id 
      AND LOWER(t.name) = LOWER(''Vicci'')
    ) THEN 90.0
    WHEN EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM event_teachers et 
      JOIN teachers t ON et.teacher_id = t.id 
      WHERE et.event_id = e.id 
      AND LOWER(t.name) LIKE LOWER(''%'' || ''Vicci'' || ''%'')
    ) THEN 70.0
    ELSE 0.0
  END as search_rank
FROM events e
WHERE (
  LOWER(e.name) LIKE LOWER(''%'' || ''Vicci'' || ''%'') OR
  LOWER(e.description) LIKE LOWER(''%'' || ''Vicci'' || ''%'') OR
  LOWER(e.city) LIKE LOWER(''%'' || ''Vicci'' || ''%'') OR
  LOWER(e.country) LIKE LOWER(''%'' || ''Vicci'' || ''%'') OR
  LOWER(e.style) LIKE LOWER(''%'' || ''Vicci'' || ''%'') OR
  EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM event_teachers et 
    JOIN teachers t ON et.teacher_id = t.id 
    WHERE et.event_id = e.id 
    AND LOWER(t.name) LIKE LOWER(''%'' || ''Vicci'' || ''%'')
  )
)
ORDER BY search_rank DESC, e.from_date ASC;
")
